# CLIProxy Image MCP

An MCP server for the OpenAI-compatible image endpoint exposed by CLIProxyAPI. It uses stdio, returns native MCP image content, and supports OpenCode on macOS and Windows.

## One-line OpenCode install

After this package is published to npm:

```sh
npx -y cliproxy-image-mcp install
```

The installer asks for the CLIProxyAPI URL, API key, and image model. It stores credentials in `~/.config/cliproxy-image-mcp/config.json` and adds the MCP server to `~/.config/opencode/opencode.json(c)`.

Restart OpenCode and ask it to use `generate_image`.

## Environment-only configuration

```text
CLIPROXY_IMAGE_BASE_URL=http://36.151.149.62
CLIPROXY_IMAGE_API_KEY=your-key
CLIPROXY_IMAGE_MODEL=gpt-image-2
```

Current OpenCode configuration:

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",
  "mcp": {
    "cliproxy-image": {
      "type": "local",
      "command": ["npx", "-y", "cliproxy-image-mcp"],
      "timeout": 300000
    }
  }
}
```

OpenCode v2 configuration (the installer detects it automatically):

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",
  "mcp": {
    "servers": {
      "cliproxy-image": {
        "type": "local",
        "command": ["npx", "-y", "cliproxy-image-mcp"],
        "timeout": 300000
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Tool

`generate_image` accepts `prompt`, `size`, `quality`, `background`, `output_format`, `save`, and `filename`. When `save` is true, it writes the result under `generated-images` in the OpenCode workspace and also returns native MCP image content.

## Development

```sh
npm install
npm test
```

Test with MCP Inspector:

```sh
npx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector node bin/cli.js
```

## Publishing

```sh
npm login
npm publish --access public
```

The package name was unclaimed when this project was created, but npm ownership is only established after publishing.
